title: Kenji concept round 2
question: Which of these is Kenji? He is 21 and at work in work clothes, with a different height, build and face in each.

media.caption: The whole round: round 1 (rejected) at the top, the five directions, then the renders I discarded because he looked over 25 or generic

options.label: kenji2-a-soft
options.note: Mop of hair, crooked tie, a LAN cable and a cat charm on the lanyard. Came out average height, not short.

options.label: kenji2-b-gangly
options.note: Tall and skinny, messy hair, pen in pocket, cat sticker on the tablet, looking away. Acne came out as freckles.

options.label: kenji2-c2-pudgy
options.note: Short and pudgy, dyed hair with roots, tie tucked in, sticky note, snacks, screwdriver. Heavier than 'a little'.

options.label: kenji2-d-freckles
options.note: Skinny, freckles, bedhead, one earbud in, sweater vest, typing on a laptop. Shares b's hair and freckles.

options.label: kenji2-e3-fringe
options.note: Blunt fringe, work jacket, keyboard and melon soda. Ears not big as asked; jacket reads a bit like a track top.
